nearProtocol.registration: Right-handed perspective cameras at matched dimensionless stations, aimed at the physical centre. Near observers integrate only forward from their eye. No Earth foreground is applied to outside references.

mergedApproximation: Encoded alpha loss is not total light loss. Isolated optical coefficients remain bounded by the exact three-copy operator; completed images can still disagree with the physical field because of post-sum tone, spectral extinction and flattened local intervals.
limits: Matched dimensionless MW near cameras. Per-camera encoded L1 must be no worse than MW; negative light, annulus and channel-share limits are the larger of the original tolerance and achieved MW error. Positive total-light error remains capped at +2%. Optical no-added-light bound is checked separately. Browser mixed-stack results remain a separate gate.
farViews: Approved model reference images exist; no new far-picture transport or site bank is installed by this near-only pilot.
decision: The native near pilot fails. Do not scale, install or run phone qualification against this bank.
